decisions.reason: Through-glass-via wafers sit close to Plan Optik's core structured-wafer competence, so keeping the option open costs little while advanced packaging demand is still uncertain but growing.
Carrier wafers are a simple extension of the existing glass wafer line with low holding cost and steady demand, so there is no reason to abandon them.
The Cu-interposer was launched at SEMICON with its own page and targets a growing packaging market, so its value is still uncertain and worth keeping open at low cost.
The Wafer Universe off-the-shelf brand mainly reuses existing inventory and production, so it is cheap to maintain, although it could be folded back into the main brand.
Glass-based circuit boards are a more distant and uncertain option with only a brief mention, but the evidence is too thin to justify abandoning them yet and holding costs are modest.
